title: Study of CM355 in Patients With Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
off: A Single-center, Open-label, Single-arm Clinical Study to Observe the Safety and Efficacy of CM355 in the Treatment of Refractory Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
sponsor: Second Xiangya Hospital of Central South University

officials.a: Second Xiangya Hospital of Central South University

summary: This study was designed to investigate the safety and efficacy of CM355 in patients with refractory SLE.
desc: This study is designed to investigate the safety and efficacy of CM355 in patients with moderately to severely active SLE who are refractory to treatment, and to analyze its pharmacokinetic profile , pharmacodynamic effects, and immunogenicity.

primary.tf: Throughout the study，an average of about 1 year
